_comment: Webcam module messages — Controller <-> Gateway <-> Agent
_consent_note: Agent MUST display a visible on-screen indicator while webcam is active. User consent is required before any frames are sent.
_binary_note: Frames use the same two-message pattern as livescreen: JSON 'frame_meta' followed by binary JPEG (ArrayBuffer).

webcam_start._desc: Request agent to start streaming webcam frames (requires user consent on Agent side)

frame_meta_webcam._desc: Sent immediately BEFORE the binary JPEG frame. module field is 'webcam' to distinguish from screen frames.

binary_frame._desc: Raw JPEG bytes (ArrayBuffer). Always follows a frame_meta with module='webcam'.

webcam_started._desc: Agent confirms webcam stream is active (user granted consent)

webcam_stopped._desc: Agent confirms webcam stream has stopped

webcam_denied._desc: Agent reports that the user denied the consent popup
